milestones.title: Reference remuneration calculator and fictional simulator
milestones.description: The reference Rust/WASM calculator and fictional simulator have a dated 26 September synthetic validation checkpoint covering remuneration, ballot decay, support fallback, demand effects and preserved acceptances. Membership, ballot authentication and policy-amendment authority remain outside this component; simulated edits and completions establish no real collective authority.
acceptance: The shared Rust/WASM reference calculator and verification-callback boundaries are documented.
The historical checks cover fictional rate, participation, decay, support-fallback and retained-term scenarios.
